mapper.sql: select foreshadow_id, work_id, title, description, status, priority, keyword, resolve_chapter_no, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_novel_foreshadow
mapper.select: where work_id = #{workId} and del_flag = '0' and status = #{status} order by case status when 'resolved' then 1 else 0 end, case priority when 'high' then 0 when 'medium' then 1 else 2 end, update_time desc, foreshadow_id desc

where work_id = #{workId} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('buried', 'pending') order by case priority when 'high' then 0 when 'medium' then 1 else 2 end, update_time desc, foreshadow_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_novel_foreshadow (work_id, title, description, status, priority, keyword, resolve_chapter_no, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{workId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{keyword}, #{resolveChapterNo}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update ai_novel_foreshadow set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where foreshadow_id = #{foreshadowId} and del_flag = '0'
